label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss) alert-TP: User-controlled 'state' parameter flows into session attribute lookup key ('oauth_state_' + state), then the retrieved 'redirect' value is used directly in response.sendRedirect(). Resolved sink value = session.getAttribute('oauth_state_'+state) which depends on attacker-controlled input. Open redirect vulnerability confirmed.

evidence.note: User 'state' param -> session lookup key -> sendRedirect(redirect)
